tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the Delivery Studio projects the caller can create tickets in

tools.name: suggest_ticket
tools.description: Suggest a ticket type, priority, subject and matching projects for a Teams message. Suggestions only; nothing is created. Use before create_ticket so the person can correct them.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Create a Delivery Studio ticket from a Teams message. Only after the person has reviewed type, priority and project.

requesterName.description: Who raised it, if not the caller

teamsMessageLink.description: Link to the Teams message, if known

teamsMessageId.description: Teams message id, used to avoid duplicates

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: List the Delivery Studio projects you can open, with id, customer, dates and your role. Start here when the person names a customer or project.

query.description: Part of a project or customer name

tools.name: project_overview
tools.description: One project at a glance: team, requirement counts by status, open questions, use cases, sessions, BRD status and open tickets, with a link.

tools.name: get_requirements
tools.description: The project requirements (id, title, objective, status, modules, acceptance). Only Confirmed ones reach the BRD.

tools.name: get_statements
tools.description: Statements taken from the workshop transcripts (what the customer said), with their review status. Pending ones are waiting for a person to accept, merge, clarify or reject.

tools.name: get_open_questions
tools.description: Questions still open for the customer or the team.

tools.name: get_use_cases
tools.description: The use cases (scenario, steps, solution, status) of the project.

tools.name: get_task_pack
tools.description: The same prepared prompt and sources that "Open in Claude" gives for a deliverable. Do the task from it, then save the result with save_draft.

task.description: brd, uat, guide, ftr, gaps, workshop, golive, hypercare, handover, wsr, monthly, config, pkg, training or closure

instruction.description: Anything extra the person asked for

tools.name: get_review_pack
tools.description: The whole project as one pack, to review for gaps, contradictions and missing information.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save the finished deliverable in Delivery Studio as an UNAPPROVED draft. A person reviews it there before it is used.

task.description: The task the pack was for, for example brd

content.description: The full text in Markdown, with the [S#] citations kept

tools.name: get_handoff
tools.description: Open the task Delivery Studio handed over when the person clicked Open in Claude: instructions, context, documents as text and the answer format. The prompt gives you the id.

id.description: The hand-off id from the prompt

tools.name: submit_handoff_result
tools.description: Send the finished answer of a hand-off back to Delivery Studio. The person sees it as a preview there and confirms it; nothing is saved until then.

result.description: The answer in the expected format

tools.name: connector_help
tools.description: What this connector can do, grouped, with ready recipes for UAT, guides, issue tracking, status reports and gap checks. Call this first when unsure.

topic.description: Optional: uat, guides, issues, status, gaps

tools.name: list_record_kinds
tools.description: Every kind of record this project holds (actions, decisions, risks and issues, change requests, sign-offs, tasks, UAT, hypercare, handover, guides, notes ...) with how many of each, plus the project documents you can read.

tools.name: get_records
tools.description: Read the records of one kind (use list_record_kinds for the kinds). Short view by default; filter by status or words; pass detail "full" to read records in depth.

kind.description: For example raid, action, decision, cr, signoff, task, utc, uat, hc, usecase, note

limit.description: How many to return (default shown in the answer)

tools.name: get_tickets
tools.description: The project tickets (including those that arrived by e-mail or from Teams): number, subject, status, priority, source, requester.

limit.description: How many to return (default shown in the answer)

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Read a project document, or one part of it. Without part it lists the parts. Sections: workshop (parts: project, modules, customModules, flows, roles, notifications, processes, requirements, questions, brd, log ...), transcripts, planner (sessions, scope), brddoc, reviews, plan_struct, notifications, agentscope, people, config_digest, config, guide_published.

limit.description: How many to return (default shown in the answer)

tools.name: search_project
tools.description: Search a word or phrase across the whole project (requirements, transcripts, flows, roles, decisions ...).

limit.description: How many to return (default shown in the answer)

tools.name: recent_activity
tools.description: What changed in the project lately and who changed it.

limit.description: How many to return (default shown in the answer)
